assets.name: Column 1 Circular Flow
assets.prompt: A vertical infographic column featuring a circular workflow diagram. On the left, three user profile icons labeled 'Business Expert', 'Safety Expert', 'Operation Expert'. In the center, a stylized blue brain icon labeled 'SFT Foundation Capability'. Surrounding the brain are curved blue arrows forming a cycle, connecting to text labels like 'Expert Preference Feedback' and 'Reward Model'. At the bottom, a row of small icons for text, image, drawing, time series, structured data. Flat design, professional blue color palette.

assets.name: Column 2 Layers
assets.prompt: A vertical infographic column divided into three horizontal sections: Input, Model, Output. Top section has a blue header and contains small icons for text filtering, image filtering, drawing filtering, time series filtering. Middle section has a green header and contains icons for safety strategy, rule constraints, risk identification. Bottom section has a purple header and contains icons for fact checking, unified refusal, compliance tuning. Flat design, clean layout.

assets.name: Column 3 RAG Flow
assets.prompt: A vertical infographic column focused on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Top row has four icons representing knowledge bases (book, gauge, network, document). Center features a large blue circle labeled 'RAG' connected by arrows to 'Tool Invocation' (wrench icon) and 'Evidence Backtracking' (magnifying glass). Bottom section shows a 'Safe Trustworthy Output' box with a shield icon and buttons for 'Verifiable', 'Real-time Update', 'Assisted Decision'. Blue theme.

assets.name: Bottom Left Flow
assets.prompt: A horizontal process flow diagram. Starts with two people icons ('Expert Feedback'), followed by a database cylinder ('Sample Accumulation'), then a brain icon ('Strategy Learning'), then a shield icon ('Safety Check'), ending with another database cylinder ('Knowledge Return'). Connected by blue arrows. Light blue background strip. Flat vector style.

assets.name: Bottom Right Icons
assets.prompt: Four distinct icons arranged horizontally. From left to right: a target/crosshair symbol, a shield with a checkmark, a document with a magnifying glass, a rising bar chart. All icons are filled with dark blue color. Flat design.

assets.name: Robot Icon
assets.prompt: A cute, simple blue robot head icon. Cartoon style, friendly face, antenna on top. White outline.

assets.name: Shield Icons
assets.prompt: Small blue shield icons with a white border. Security symbol. Flat design.

assets.name: Checkmark Shield
assets.prompt: A large blue shield icon containing a white checkmark in the center. Represents security or verification. Flat design.
